positions.title: Software Engineer, Machine Learning
positions.description: Software engineer focused on building, designing, and testing ML-driven solutions for real world problems.

positions.title: Rice University Class of 2026
positions.description: Bachelors with a double major in Computer Science and Statistics, minor in Data Science.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Independently designed and developed a full-stack web application using Frappe/ERPNext framework, replacing over 10,000 Excel files with a centralized SQL database.
• Led the creation of a workflow platform for seamless tracking of lab test requests and progress, used by 30+ engineers to enhance collaboration and communication
• Boosted operational efficiency and data accuracy by designing a user-friendly interface that sped up the process of handling lab tests, improving turnaround time by 40%, entirely self-directed.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Python (Programming Language) · Databases · R (Programming Language) · Statistical Data Analysis · Data Visualization · JavaScript

positions.title: Summer Programming Instructor
positions.description: Created curriculum and instructed a beginner-oriented Python class to middle school students. Taught basic data types, functions, and loops. By the end, the students were able to construct simple Python projects such as Hangman and Madlibs.

positions.title: Summer Camp Counselor
positions.description: Assisted with the day-to-day operations of a Summer Camp.

honors.title: Computer Science Club Co-Founder
honors.description: Co-Founded our schools first computer science club. Organized meetings and brought in guests from the field.
